text.tspan: Dynamic scaling reacts AFTER the spike; scheduled scaling is ready BEFORE it
for the first ~5 minutes every morning
Use scheduled when you KNOW the time: office-hours spikes, flash sales / launches, month-end batch, dev/QA to zero at night.
Predictive scaling = AWS learns repeating daily/weekly patterns; it can't predict a one-off launch.
